event_text: The state finds a cybersecurity incident in which an unauthorized user accessed myColorado platform data, and shuts the app down
notes: The state says 'late Wednesday night, Nov. 18'.

event_text: The state posts an update: the app stays offline with no restoration date, and 50,000 to 150,000 people's data may be affected
The state says the incident mainly involved users' uploaded documents, estimates roughly 100,000 users' data was involved, and says notices will begin on Nov 27
